text: ls src/ | rg prelude; echo "---"; head -40 src/var_export_prelude.rs: ::__set_state(array( … ))`, and an enum case as //! `\Enum::Case`. PHP's object layout is NOT the array layout — an entry key sits //! at `indent + 3` (arrays use `indent + 2`) while the value and the closing line //! keep the array indents — which is why the object branch does not reuse the //! array branch's padding. Property visibility is deliberately absent: unlike //! `print_r`, PHP's `var_export` prints the bare property name. //! - Object properties are reached through four `internal: true` helpers //! (`__elephc_object_is_enum`, `__elephc_object_prop_count`, //! `__elephc_object_prop_name`, `__elephc_object_prop_value`) because elephc has //! no `get_object_vars()`, no object-to-array cast, and no `foreach` over a plain //! object — and because `enum_exists()` needs a string literal in AOT mode, so a //! prelude holding a runtime `mixed` cannot ask whether it is an enum any other
